'''Valara''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the war with the Sith Empire. For years, he operated on Imperial planets by helping [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] in doubt escape from their ruthless training and join the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. While smuggling a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he attracted the attention of an [[HK-51]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]], who obtained the coded signal acolytes used to contact him. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] considered Valara for elimination among two other targets.

==Behind the scenes==
Valara was mentioned ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. He was originally slated to appear in game but the content was cut. His in game appearance is shown to be [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar (species)]] in a datamined file found [https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/master-valara here].
